column14: readme: first thing to note is that the time of return in other sheet is when the bee is first seen in the video, it is not the time of hole entry. So the time you hear the beep on the light level camera (when bee enters hole) will be a several seconds after the time the bee has returned. this doesnt mean the different camera times are not synched. The time of return is very highly correlated with the time of the decision i think. Bees generally race through to the decision chamber.
